title: JSON -0 (an int for Python) is written as '-0.0'
culprit: serde_json parses `-0` as f64 -0.0; config_ini.rs ConfigValue::from_json -> pyfmt::float_str
suggested_fix: detect integer syntax (no '.', 'e', 'E') in the number's text (arbitrary_precision) and format it as an integer
